newsitem.title: FRANCE: French industrial output seen rising -Bk of France.
newsitem.headline: French industrial output seen rising -Bk of France.

text.p: The Bank of France said on Tuesday its latest monthly survey of business leaders showed industrial output had "generally stabilised" in May and was expected to "advance appreciably" in all sectors in coming months.
"According to business leaders surveyed by the Banque de France, industrial output generally stabilised in May, following a sharp upturn in April," it said in a statement.
"The automobile sector was the only one to register a decline, which was accentuated by calendar effects," it said.

"Over the coming months industrial output is likely to advance appreciably in all sectors. The best performances are expected from the food-processing industry and the capital and intermediate goods sectors," it said.

"Overall demand changed little," it said, speaking of the month of May. "On the domestic market inter-industry demand was less buoyant than in April, whereas foreign demand, boosted by the strength of the dollar and the pound sterling, remained firm. Orders continued to stream in from the English-speaking, Asian and East European markets."
"The capacity ultilisation rate fell back slightly from one month to the next," it said.

"Retail activity perked up considerably in May," it said. "(But) the installation of new equipment, which was judged necessary at the beginning of the year, is taking place only very gradually, in particular at small and medium sized companies," it said.
